description:
The scheme is known as the "Sambal Scheme for the Welfare of Construction Workers."

It is implemented by the Government of India.

The scheme aims to provide financial assistance and welfare benefits to construction workers.

The objectives include improving the living standards of construction workers and ensuring their social security.

Benefits include financial assistance for medical emergencies education and housing.

The scheme also provides skill development training and insurance coverage.

Eligibility criteria include being a registered construction worker under the Building and Other Construction Workers Act.

Applicants must be aged between 18 and 60 years.

The application process involves registration with the local labor department.

Workers need to submit relevant documents such as identity proof and proof of employment.

The timeline for processing applications may vary by state.

The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Labour and Employment.

State governments also play a role in the implementation of the scheme.

Additional details may include periodic reviews and updates to the scheme based on worker feedback.
